contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"tight_H9","text":"If Mateo Brann (CF) had stood 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the shot chance would have been essentially unchanged — moving Brann closer would not have reduced the 4.6% chance to score."},{"experiment_id":"tight_H2","text":"If Noah Fairley (RB) had stood 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the shot chance would have been essentially unchanged — Fairley closing that distance would not have reduced the 4.6% chance to score."},{"experiment_id":"tight_H5","text":"If Ruben Saldo (CB) had stood 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the shot chance would have been essentially unchanged — Saldo being 5 m nearer would not have reduced the 4.6% chance to score."}]}
